# bash completion for mgit (generated by `mgit --completions bash`)
_mgit_complete() {
    local cur prev word command
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
    command=""
    case "$command:$prev" in
        :--mouse) return ;;
        :--sync) return ;;
        :--completions) return ;;
    esac
    if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
        case "$command" in
            *) COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "--mouse --sync --completions --help --version" -- "$cur")) ;;
        esac
    else
        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -f -- "$cur"))
    fi
}
complete -o filenames -F _mgit_complete mgit
